title: Published human research lap — BMW Z4 GT3 at Red Bull Ring
attribution: AssettoCorsaGym, Adrian Remonda et al., NeurIPS 2024
quality_notes: A real human Assetto Corsa research recording; not an expert or world-record claim.
Observed at most two tyres off track and no pit entry; penalties were disabled and official lap validity is unverified.
Fuel use and tyre wear were disabled. Setup, mod versions, BoP and weather are not fully verified.
This BMW lap is not compatible with a Mercedes-AMG GT3 merely because both are GT3 cars.
Source header specifies Slick Medium (M); this label must not be silently equated to another compound name.
transformations: Selected Session Lap Count=3 (fourth numbered lap) from the published human stint.
Removed post-finish position-wrap samples before the lagging lap counter changed.
Converted seconds to milliseconds and pedal percentages to ratios; retained speed in km/h and lateral acceleration in g.
Preserved original steering degrees in an extra CSV column; no wheel-lock normalization was invented.
